unanswered.text: Husband's 70th Birthday. Just came to chill and try the beer and food. Everything was off the chain great. We had Fish and Chips, seasoned fries cooked to perfection! The fish was meaty. Pulled Pork Tacos (2) BBQ style was amazing! The pulled pork was spot on! I had to take one to go as I was full! We had the Housemade Gorgonzola Potato Chips which went really well with the flight of beers we tried. Flight: Red Cent; Imperial Red IPA; Casey's Black IPA & Motivation Destroyer IPA! EXCELLENT!!! We'll be back for sure.
unanswered.draftReply: Alicia, what a way to celebrate your husband's 70th! So glad the Fish and Chips and Pulled Pork Tacos hit the spot, and that beer flight sounds like the perfect way to sample the lineup. Thanks for bringing the celebration to us -- come back soon, there's so much more to try!

unanswered.text: Beer was not good at all. Got botulism from taco. Recovering now. Avoid this place.
unanswered.draftReply: Donald, we're sorry to hear your visit didn't meet the mark and take any health concern seriously -- we'd like to look into this directly, so please reach out to us at the restaurant with more details on your order and timing. We hold our food and beer to a high standard and want the chance to make it right.
